description: This file defines classes and interfaces for safe, reference-counted access to file descriptors within the 'cuttlefish' namespace. It includes the SharedFD class for managing file descriptors with automatic lifetime management, the FileInstance class representing individual file descriptor instances, and related utility classes such as WeakFD and ScopedMMap. The file also declares external dependencies and includes platform-specific code for Linux. It is part of a larger project related to Android and virtualization, focusing on safe file descriptor handling.

classes.name: SharedFD
classes.description: A reference-counted, safe wrapper around a file descriptor, providing methods for creation, duplication, and comparison, with automatic lifetime management.

classes.name: WeakFD
classes.description: A non-owning weak reference to a SharedFD, allowing to attempt to lock and obtain a SharedFD.

classes.name: ScopedMMap
classes.description: A RAII wrapper for memory-mapped regions, ensuring proper cleanup.

classes.name: FileInstance
classes.description: Represents an individual file descriptor instance, managing its lifecycle and providing POSIX-like operations.

methods.name: SharedFD()
methods.description: Default constructor initializing to a closed file descriptor.

methods.name: SharedFD(const std::shared_ptr<FileInstance>& in)
methods.description: Constructs a SharedFD from an existing FileInstance shared pointer.

methods.name: Accept
methods.description: Accepts a new connection on a listening socket.

methods.name: Dup
methods.description: Duplicates an existing unmanaged file descriptor.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens a file and returns a SharedFD.

methods.name: SocketPair
methods.description: Creates a pair of connected sockets.

methods.name: SocketLocalClient
methods.description: Creates a Unix domain socket client.

methods.name: GetVhostUserVsockServerAddr
methods.description: Returns address string for vhost-user VSOCK server.

methods.name: GetVhostUserVsockClientAddr
methods.description: Returns address string for vhost-user VSOCK client.

methods.name: ErrorFD
methods.description: Creates a SharedFD representing an error state.

methods.name: lock
methods.description: Attempts to obtain a SharedFD from a WeakFD.
